patch_description: The highest-scoring prior program (sum 2.61, score 0.99) combined lattice seeds + heuristic refinement with an SLSQP continuous polish. The current program regressed to 2.42 because it lost the SLSQP step. I restore and strengthen it: keep the fast seed/refine pipeline, then run SLSQP (maximize sum of radii over centers+radii with pairwise and wall constraints), repair the result with exact Gauss-Seidel growth, and add iterative restart passes — feeding the repaired solution back into SLSQP from the feasible endpoint until no further improvement, keeping the best valid configuration. Validity is always guaranteed since radii come from exact feasible growth.
